sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A human that was dispatched to the forest by a certain organization. Fearing a strike from the therianthropic tribe, Navarr suggests that the elves begin preparing defensive measures. However, as the elven queen wanted to reconcile with the tribesmen, she claimed this would be counterproductive. Although the peace negotiations she proposed actually went rather well, everything came to an abrupt end when one of the therianthropes tore the elven queen's chest apart. This was the catalyst for an all out war between the two peoples. Rumor has it that Navarr had actually spoken to the therianthropic girl who murdered the elven queen before the incident took place, but there are no more details available on the matter.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Dark Ice Navarr |bf2 = true }} '''Navarr''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A human that was dispatched to the forest by a certain organization. Fearing a strike from the therianthropic tribe, Navarr suggests that the elves begin preparing defensive measures. However, as the elven queen wanted to reconcile with the tribesmen, she claimed this would be counterproductive. Although the peace negotiations she proposed actually went rather well, everything came to an abrupt end when one of the therianthropes tore the elven queen's chest apart. This was the catalyst for an all out war between the two peoples. Rumor has it that Navarr had actually spoken to the therianthropic girl who murdered the elven queen before the incident took place, but there are no more details available on the matter. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Navarr |element = Water |image1 = Navi chara bf2 59 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 59 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 59 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 59 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 59 4.png |image5note = Shock }} ==Trivia==
